Okay, here are some prominent office furniture brand websites, categorized for easier browsing:

**Major & Well-Known Brands:**

*   **Steelcase:** [https://www.steelcase.com/](https://www.steelcase.com/) (Global leader, known for innovation, design, and sustainability)
*   **Herman Miller:** [https://www.hermanmiller.com/](https://www.hermanmiller.com/) (Iconic designs, ergonomic focus, and a strong brand reputation)
*   **Knoll:** [https://www.knoll.com/](https://www.knoll.com/) (Modern design heritage, high-end aesthetic, part of MillerKnoll)
*   **Haworth:** [https://www.haworth.com/](https://www.haworth.com/) (Globally recognized, offers a wide range of office solutions)
*   **Allsteel:** [https://www.allsteeloffice.com/](https://www.allsteeloffice.com/) (Part of HNI Corporation, known for durability and value)

**Mid-Range & Value-Focused Brands:**

*   **HON:** [https://www.hon.com/](https://www.hon.com/) (Part of HNI Corporation, a popular choice for small to medium-sized businesses)
*   **Global Furniture Group:** [https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com/](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com/) (Wide variety of styles and price points)
*   **Bush Business Furniture:** [https://www.bushbusinessfurniture.com/](https://www.bushbusinessfurniture.com/)
*   **Bestar:** [https://bestar.ca/en/](https://bestar.ca/en/)
*   **Monarch Specialties:** [https://monarchspec.com/](https://monarchspec.com/)

**Specialty & Ergonomic Brands:**

*   **Humanscale:** [https://www.humanscale.com/](https://www.humanscale.com/) (Focus on ergonomics and user-friendly design)
*   **Neutral Posture:** [https://www.neutralposture.com/](https://www.neutralposture.com/) (Ergonomic seating and accessories)
*   **BodyBilt:** [https://bodybilt.com/](https://bodybilt.com/) (Ergonomic chairs with a focus on adjustability and support)
*   **Sitmatic:** [https://www.sitmatic.com/](https://www.sitmatic.com/) (Durable chairs, particularly for industrial and specialized settings)

**European Brands:**

*   **Vitra:** [https://www.vitra.com/](https://www.vitra.com/) (Swiss company, known for iconic designs and collaborations with famous designers)
*   **Sedus Stoll:** [https://www.sedus.com/](https://www.sedus.com/) (German manufacturer, focusing on ergonomic and sustainable solutions)
*   **Bene:** [https://bene.com/en/](https://bene.com/en/) (Austrian company, offers innovative office concepts and designs)

**Canadian Brands:**

*   **Artopex:** [https://artopex.com/](https://artopex.com/)

**Online Retailers with Private Label Brands (and Often Reselling Others):**

*   **Wayfair:** [https://www.wayfair.com/](https://www.wayfair.com/)
*   **Amazon:** [https://www.amazon.com/](https://www.amazon.com/)
*   **Office Depot/OfficeMax:** [https://www.officedepot.com/](https://www.officedepot.com/)
*   **Staples:** [https://www.staples.com/](https://www.staples.com/)

**Important Considerations When Choosing:**

*   **Budget:** Prices vary *significantly* between brands.
*   **Style/Aesthetics:**  Consider the overall look you want to achieve in your office.  Modern, traditional, minimalist, etc.
*   **Ergonomics:**  Prioritize ergonomic features, especially for chairs and desks.
*   **Durability:**  For high-use environments, choose durable materials and construction.
*   **Warranty:**  Check the warranty offered by the manufacturer.
*   **Functionality:**  Does the furniture meet your specific needs (e.g., storage, adjustability, etc.)?
*   **Sustainability:**  If environmental impact is a concern, look for brands with sustainable practices and certifications.
*   **Space:** Measure your space and make sure the furniture fits properly

This list is not exhaustive, but it provides a good starting point for exploring office furniture brands. Good luck with your search!
